The '''RCS computer system''' was manufactured by [[Miradyne Limited]]. The system was used in [[Starfeld Industries/Legends|Starfeld Industries]]' [[Z-10 Seeker-class scout ship|Z-10 ''Seeker''-class scout ship]].<ref name="SS" /> The [[RCS-1]] and [[RCS-6 flight avionics system|RCS-6]] were example of RCS [[Computer/Legends|computers]].<ref name="J5">{{JournalCite|5|A Buyer's Guide to Alternative Starships}}</ref>
